A favorite in Kakariko Village.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Pumpkin Stews are [[Meal]]s that can be made by [[Cooking]] a [[Fortified Pumpkin]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Fresh Milk]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The only way to make regular Pumpkin Stew is to add ingredients to the [[Recipe]] that contradict the tough effect. [[Link]] can eat them to restore some of his [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. These Meals are favored in [[Kakariko Village]]. The ''[[Girl's Notebook]]'', which can be found in [[Hateno Village]], details the recipe for Pumpkin Stew. The author describes it as a secret recipe that will surprise the most knowledgeable of fathers, instructing the reader to start with some Fortified Pumpkins.{{Cite|For a secret recipe that'll surprise even the most knowledgeable of dads, start with some {{Color BotW|Blue|fortified pumpkins}}.|Girl's Notebook|BotW}} Next, she suggests to add Tabantha Wheat for a "wheaty flavor", and then to let the Fresh Milk and Goat Butter simmer.{{Cite|Throw in some {{Color BotW|Blue|Tabantha wheat}} to give the stew a nice wheaty flavor, then let some {{Color BotW|Blue|fresh milk}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|goat butter}} simmer.|Girl's Notebook|BotW}} The recipe is concluded by telling the reader they should now have Pumpkin Stew.{{Cite|And there you have it! A tasty {{Color BotW|Blue|pumpkin stew}}!|Girl's Notebook|BotW}} Only one variation of Pumpkin Stew can be made: * '''Tough Pumpkin Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Pumpkin Stew}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Simply simmer a fortified pumpkin to make this dish. A favorite in Kakariko Village.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using the default recipe. When these Stews are eaten, [[Link]] will receive a boost to his defensive abilities. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Two variations of Pumpkin Stew can be made: * '''Sunny Pumpkin Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sunny Pumpkin Stew}}
Restores hearts damaged by gloom.
Simply simmer a pumpkin to make this dish. A favorite in Kakariko Village.|Inventory|TotK}} Made by using [[Sun Pumpkin]]s. When these Stews are eaten, several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s damaged by [[Gloom]] will be restored. * '''Tough Pumpkin Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Pumpkin Stew}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Simply simmer a pumpkin to make this dish. A favorite in Kakariko Village.|Inventory|TotK}} Made by using [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s. When these Stews are eaten, [[Link]] will receive a boost to his defensive abilities. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The recipe for Pumpkin Stew is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[The Pumpkin Hunt]]". It is made using four [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s, four [[Tabantha Wheat]], four [[Fresh Milk]]s, and four Goat Butters. However, it can be lowered to three of each ingredient through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]s will recover health for every [[Enemy]] KO. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Pumpkin Stew Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Pumpkin Stew ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Meat-Stuffed Pumpkin * Pumpkin Pie }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Stews |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
